description: This file contains utility functions and default configurations for engine control software, including setting engine parameters, managing configuration states, and referencing external hardware and sensor modules. It also includes functions for copying and initializing engine configuration tables.

methods.name: rememberCurrentConfiguration
methods.description: Copies the current engine configuration into a local activeConfiguration variable for later comparison.

methods.name: incrementGlobalConfigurationVersion
methods.description: Increments the global configuration version counter and triggers callbacks for configuration changes.

methods.name: setConstantDwell
methods.description: Sets a constant dwell time across the entire RPM range.

methods.name: setAfrMap
methods.description: Sets the AFR target map with a specified value.

methods.name: setMap
methods.description: Sets a fuel map with a specified value.

methods.name: setWholeVEMap
methods.description: Sets the entire volumetric efficiency map to a specified value.

methods.name: setWholeFuelMap
methods.description: Sets the entire fuel map to a specified value.

methods.name: setWholeIgnitionIatCorr
methods.description: Sets the entire ignition IAT correction table to a specified value.

methods.name: setFuelTablesLoadBin
methods.description: Sets load bins for fuel tables.

methods.name: setTimingMap
methods.description: Sets the ignition timing map with a specified value.

methods.name: setWholeTimingTable_d
methods.description: Sets the entire ignition timing table to a specified value.

methods.name: initTemperatureCurve
methods.description: Initializes temperature-based correction curves with default values.

methods.name: setDefaultFsioParameters
methods.description: Sets default parameters for FSIO (Flexible I/O) configuration.

methods.name: prepareVoidConfiguration
methods.description: Resets engine configuration to default empty state with unassigned pins and default settings.

methods.name: setDefaultBasePins
methods.description: Sets default base pin assignments for engine control pins.

methods.name: setDefaultSerialParameters
methods.description: Sets default serial communication parameters.

methods.name: setDefaultSdCardParameters
methods.description: Sets default SD card interface parameters.

methods.name: setBosch02880155868
methods.description: Configures injector calibration parameters for Bosch 02880155868 injectors.

methods.name: setDefaultWarmupIdleCorrection
methods.description: Initializes idle correction curves for warmup conditions.

methods.name: setDefaultWarmupFuelEnrichment
methods.description: Initializes fuel enrichment curves for warmup conditions.

methods.name: setDefaultFuelCutParameters
methods.description: Sets default parameters for fuel cut during deceleration.

methods.name: setDefaultCrankingSettings
methods.description: Sets default cranking parameters based on temperature.

methods.name: setDefaultIdleSpeedTarget
methods.description: Sets default idle speed target based on temperature.

methods.name: setDefaultStepperIdleParameters
methods.description: Sets default parameters for stepper idle control.

methods.name: setCanDefaults
methods.description: Sets default CAN bus communication parameters.

methods.name: setTargetRpmCurve
methods.description: Defines a target RPM curve for idle control based on temperature.

methods.name: setDefaultConfiguration
methods.description: Establishes the global default engine configuration, overriding with engine-specific defaults.

methods.name: validateConfiguration
methods.description: Checks and corrects configuration parameters for validity.

methods.name: applyNonPersistentConfiguration
methods.description: Applies configuration settings that do not persist after reboot, such as hardware initialization.

methods.name: prepareShapes
methods.description: Prepares output signals and fuel injection events based on current configuration.

methods.name: getRpmMultiplier
methods.description: Returns a multiplier for RPM based on engine operation mode.

methods.name: setOperationMode
methods.description: Sets the engine operation mode (e.g., cam sensor, crank sensor).

methods.name: getOperationMode
methods.description: Retrieves the current engine operation mode.

methods.name: commonFrankensoAnalogInputs
methods.description: Configures common analog input channels for a Frankenso board.

methods.name: setFrankenso0_1_joystick
methods.description: Configures joystick input pins for Frankenso.

methods.name: copyTargetAfrTable
methods.description: Copies target AFR table data from source to destination.

methods.name: copyFuelTable
methods.description: Copies fuel table data from source to destination.

methods.name: copyTimingTable
methods.description: Copies ignition timing table data from source to destination.
